questions.cypher: MATCH (ev:Event)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(n:Entity) WHERE toLower(ev.title) CONTAINS 'apple' AND ev.started_at >= $today_start AND ev.started_at < $today_start + duration({hours: 24}) RETURN ev.key AS event_key, ev.title AS event_title, n.name AS name, n.type AS type, ev.page_count AS pages, ev.started_at AS started_at ORDER BY ev.page_count DESC LIMIT 25
